_howTo: Each project is one card. 'team' is optional. For each person: 'name' (required), 'role', 'lead' (true for the project lead, who is shown first with a Lead tag), 'photo' (a path like images/members/jane-doe.jpg; with no photo their initials are shown) and 'linkedin' (optional link on their name). 'status' is optional (for example 'In progress'). The team below is PLACEHOLDER: replace it with the real people.

projects.name: FIRESAT
projects.description: FIRESAT (Fire Intervention and Rescue Expedition Satellite) is a student-led aerospace research initiative developing a low-cost wildfire detection system for future integration into a 3U CubeSat. The project aims to test the AI model Sundance for thermal-based wildfire detection under mission-like conditions on a high-altitude balloon (HAB), combining aerospace engineering, embedded systems, and artificial intelligence.
